poc_plan: Week 0: Provision Dedicated pool (2 nodes H100-equivalent) in us-west and europe-west; network peering to customer VPC; set KMS integration
Week 1: Deploy model variants: l2-13b-quant (cost profile) + l2-70b (high-quality) with pinned versions; run baseline perf tests
Canary: route 10% of production traffic to Dedicated pool for 72h; monitor latency p50/p95, token cost, error rates
Fallbacks: automatic fallback to Hosted API if {{latency_p95}} > 2x baseline OR error_rate > 0.5% for 5m
Region failover: if primary region (us-west) reports sustained degraded health for 3m, route traffic to europe-west Dedicated variant; if both degraded, fallback to Hosted in closest region
Rollback criteria: degraded QA metrics (response correctness drop > 3% on eval prompts) OR cost unexpectedly > 25% above estimate => rollback to previous model variant and escalate to AE/SE
Observability: add per-route dashboards, tracing hook, and token-level cost alerts; set weekly sync with product and infra owners
acceptance_criteria: p50 latency <= 120ms for typical chat prompt mix
token unit cost reduction >= 30% vs current provider for heavy chat workloads
no data exfiltration issues in security scan; SAML + KMS flows validated
